integrity: Analytic area/transfer proof with separately reproducible finite numerical corroboration; publication priority remains subject to external verification.
scientific_limitations: The exact TV optimum is for one step at beta=sqrt(2); the stationary-law bound is necessary, not sharpness. Scope is the fixed-coin triangular model 1<beta<=3/2; no claims about other digit selectors or higher beta. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Sharp uniform-area obstruction and optimal one-step drift on fat Sierpinski triangles
